macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds after sharp selloff and $1.1 billion liquidation wave
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered toward $83,000 after falling to about $80,350 on October 9. The decline triggered more than $1 billion in crypto liquidations, reportedly the largest long-position wipeout in roughly 90 days.

items.title: Starknet token surges 44% as network considers moving beyond Ethereum
items.summary: Starknet’s token rose 44% in one day amid discussion that the network could leave Ethereum to address concerns related to quantum computing and long-term security.

items.title: Blockchain.com seeks U.S. licenses for prediction markets and crypto derivatives
items.summary: Blockchain.com reportedly applied to the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission for licenses that would allow it to operate a federally regulated derivatives exchange and broker serving retail and institutional customers.

items.title: China’s national blockchain-network plans lift Conflux
items.summary: A Chinese policy document outlined plans for a nationwide blockchain and integrated computing network, sending Conflux’s CFX token sharply higher—reported at about 28% in initial coverage. The initiative does not indicate that China has lifted its restrictions on cryptocurrency trading.

items.title: EU crypto firms face stablecoin compliance deadline under MiCA
items.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority said MiCA-licensed firms must eliminate remaining exposure to non-compliant stablecoins by January 8, 2027, including ceasing related trading, custody, transfers and advice for EU clients.

items.title: Ledger wallet incident leaves millions in cryptocurrency under attacker control
items.summary: Monitoring cited by Galaxy Research reportedly found about $72.9 million still held in attacker-controlled addresses following the Ledger-related attack, with additional funds moved through Tornado Cash, cross-chain transfers and other laundering routes.

items.title: Meanwhile raises total funding above $180 million
items.summary: Meanwhile, a Bermuda-based crypto company backed by investors including OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, has raised its cumulative funding above $180 million.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Microsoft unveils Microsoft-Decision-1 scoring model
items.summary: Microsoft announced Microsoft-Decision-1, a fast decision-scoring model post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B. The company says it is available through Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output tokens.

items.title: Mistral previews trillion-parameter Large 4 model
items.summary: Mistral launched a preview of Mistral Large 4, an open-weight, natively multimodal model with 1 trillion total parameters and 49 billion active parameters. The API is available now, with model weights expected later this month.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Haiku 5.5, positioning it as a faster and lower-cost model for high-volume workloads such as summarization and classification. Reports describe new effort controls and substantially reduced pricing compared with its predecessor.

items.title: Reflection AI introduces open-weight Beam model
items.summary: Reflection AI released Beam, a text-only mixture-of-experts model with 501 billion total parameters, 23 billion active parameters, and up to a 1-million-token context window. The company claims competitive reasoning performance with lower inference compute, though those claims have not been independently verified.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases EmbeddingGemma 2
items.summary: Google DeepMind released EmbeddingGemma 2 under the Apache 2.0 license. The model is designed to represent text, code, images, video, and audio in a shared 768-dimensional embedding space.

items.title: Sierra and Meta announce personal-agent protocol
items.summary: Sierra, Meta, and partners including Genesys, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart announced an open standard for consumer personal agents to authenticate and act across company websites, APIs, and agents. The planned specification uses OAuth-based sessions and supports read and write actions.

items.title: Google Cloud introduces enterprise Gemini agent
items.summary: Google Cloud unveiled a Gemini-powered agent designed to handle multiday enterprise workflows across Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Slack, using Gemini and other AI models.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 and Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI announced the rollout of GPT-6 in ChatGPT alongside Intelligent UI, which adds interactive elements such as charts, buttons, and forms to responses. The rollout reportedly uses different GPT-6 variants across subscription tiers.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Cloud Imperium Games to Release Squadron 42 on Steam
items.summary: Cloud Imperium Games announced that the long-awaited single-player space game Squadron 42 will be released on Steam, adding a major distribution platform to the project.

items.title: EU Targets Video-Game Microtransaction Practices
items.summary: The European Commission is investigating ten companies, including Ubisoft, Activision Blizzard, Riot Games, Mojang, King, and Supercell, over virtual-currency systems that may encourage consumers to purchase more in-game currency than needed. Fortnite is expected to introduce more exact V-Bucks purchases beginning October 14.

items.title: Ubisoft to Shut Down Rainbow Six Mobile
items.summary: Ubisoft and Vantage Studios announced that support for the free-to-play mobile shooter Rainbow Six Mobile will end, with servers scheduled to close on January 15, 2027.

items.title: Nintendo Announces The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake
items.summary: Nintendo officially announced a remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2, with release planned for 2026.

items.title: Hitman Classic Trilogy Announced for 2027
items.summary: IO Interactive announced Hitman Classic Trilogy, which will bring updated versions of Hitman: Codename 47, Hitman 2: Silent Assassin, and Hitman: Contracts to modern platforms in 2027.

items.title: Silver Pines Launches on Consoles and PC
items.summary: Wych Elm released the Twin Peaks-inspired survival horror game Silver Pines on consoles and PC.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day Reportedly Sells 230,000 Copies
items.summary: Analytics firm Alinea Analytics estimates that Gears of War: E-Day has sold approximately 230,000 copies since its early-access launch on October 1 and its full release on October 6.

items.title: Google and Unity Introduce AI Game-Creation Tools
items.summary: Google introduced Playground, an experimental browser-based generative-AI platform for creating simple games through natural-language prompts, while Unity presented its Spark platform for AI-assisted game development.

items.title: GTA VI Leaker Threatens to Release a Playable Build
items.summary: An anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek reportedly threatened to publish a complete playable build of Grand Theft Auto VI ahead of its scheduled November 19 release. A related Solana meme coin surged sharply after the claim.

items.title: Paramount Developing Cyberpunk 2077 Film
items.summary: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action film set in the Cyberpunk 2077 universe with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, a development that also lifted CD Projekt’s shares in trading reported by Reuters.
